_vars.base: Two watercolor river channels painted in perspective as if the viewer stands at the confluence point. The left river recedes from lower-center toward the upper-left, its wash tapering with distance. The right river recedes from lower-center toward the upper-right, also tapering into the distance. The convergence zone at the bottom-center is the widest and most vivid part. Thin ink lines sketch the river bends. Bare cream parchment all around.
_vars.color: both rivers painted in the same cool blue-gray watercolor wash, layered transparent pigment, soft blooming edges
_vars.style: watercolor ink wash illustration on completely flat solid cream background color #F5EFE3, no background texture no gradient pure flat single color background, delicate ink lines tracing the river channels, abstract river forms floating on bare parchment, no landscape, no vegetation, no sky, no people, no text, no logos
_vars.neg: aerial top-down view, trees, grass, sky, clouds, horizon, hills, people, figures, text, logos, photorealistic, dark background, textured background, gradient background, patterned background, noisy background, paper texture, watercolor paper, canvas texture, different colors
